best: The four-switch buck-boost and the BQ29 protection power path are drawn as textbook left-to-right power paths with titled, dashed blocks and short explanatory notes on every block.
worst: BQ25756 charger connects to its FETs, bootstrap and sense nets mostly by local net labels (HIDRV1, SW1, SRP_F, FB...) rather than wires, so the gate-drive and sense loops must be traced by name
Stacked GND pin numbers overlap on U401/U405 in the USB sheets, and USB Port 2 notes still cite Port 1 refs (D401, U405, Q401, R424/R427)
Gauge sheet uses long orthogonal detour wires from cell taps and FET_MID into U101, plus local labels CELL1-CELL_4P/TS2-TS3 between blocks on the same sheet
